The commits are conventional with bodies and carry no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no attribution trailer. justifications.goal_fidelity: Every clause of plan section 15 is met. The four ref-validation sites now answer through declared_section_identities: reckon/_schema.py:589 section_dependency_refusals, and the roadmap staged-ref checks for after (_after_edges, roadmap.py:818), section-scoped (_section_scoped_edges, roadmap.py:944) and hard (_build_roadmap, roadmap.py:2471) edges. The private _declared_stages union is retired in favour of the owner; the _gate_section_refs fallback (roadmap.py:221) and promotion.py:7276 reach the owner too, and the readiness split (roadmap.py:3004) unions the owner's set so a typed-record-only section appears. The file-aware read (_plan_authored_state) is threaded with the inventoried docs_dir into the after, section-scoped and declared_for sites and reads a plan file's typed sections as well as its declarations, so a section living only in the file resolves at every site. plan_section_anchors keeps its narrower gate and comment meaning.
justifications.reuse: _declared_stages is retired in favour of declared_section_identities, so one function now answers section existence for refs, gates and decision scopes, a genuine de-duplication and the change's main reuse win; plan_section_anchors is retained but only for its narrower gate and comment role, and no caller is left holding a fork of the union. Held below 19 because _plan_authored_state is called twice for the same plan in the readiness block (roadmap.py:2953 and 2962), each call building a fresh dict copy of the row before the memoised file read, and _gate_section_edges.declared_for rebuilds a set from the owner's frozenset on every target lookup; both are bounded by the memoised read, so efficiency only.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff touches exactly reckon/_schema.py, reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_section_refs_resolve_declared_sections.py and docs/evidence/fragments/section-contract-and-computed-impl/section-refs-resolve-declared-sections.html, every one inside the dispatch FENCE scope list; no shared project index, sprint state, other plan or out-of-scope path is touched, and the granted figure directory is not written. No breach, and no declared path left under-delivered.
